resumo: Pintura a óleo em tela de linho grosso, estilo folk ingênuo. Figura solitária de costas, pequena no quadro, rosto nunca visível. Luz difusa, horizonte enevoado, empastamento visível.
abertura: Textured oil painting on rough linen canvas, naive folk-art style.

figura.padrao: Solitary figure seen from behind, small in frame, face never visible, wearing a simple long coat, painted in loose confident brushstrokes.
figura.surreal: Seen from behind, small in frame, face never visible, painted in loose confident brushstrokes.

luz: Soft diffused light, hazy horizon, no hard shadows.
materia: Thick visible impasto texture, canvas weave showing through, subtle film grain, slightly desaturated, muted and dreamlike.
respiro: Wide open negative space in the {zona} third of the frame, empty and low-contrast, reserved for text overlay.
clima: Painterly, contemplative, quiet, melancholic but hopeful.
trava_referencia: Match the painting style, brushwork, impasto texture and colour handling of the reference image. Do NOT copy its composition or subject.
negativos: No text, no lettering, no watermark, no signature, no faces, no logos.

paletas.P1: Soft cobalt blue, sage green, pale cream horizon, gentle rose light
paletas.P2: Muted slate grey, sea green, warm sand, overcast pale sky
paletas.P3: Burnt orange, deep amber, indigo shadow, golden sparks
paletas.P4: Dusty pink, warm terracotta, soft lavender, cream
